notes.subject: tifawt
notes.rationale: הצפרה: KJV 'the morning', ASV 'thy doom', JPS 'the turn' — seg unamak n tzemmart neɣ n tnefsert n wawal; sfireɣ 'tifawt' (tafadist) maca anzay d talɣa n ussigim

notes.subject: הצפרה / צץ
notes.rationale: Alliteracy n ṣadi: tsefira-yessiṭṭef d ṣṣuṣ, taywalit-agi tṛuḥu s teqbaylit

notes.subject: צץ / פרח
notes.rationale: Sinri n wemdan: snat n tfeqliwin (tigejt tefri / timeɛrent tefri) — tseddart n tmeẓẓist tettwasegzum s yiwet n talɣa

notes.subject: Wali
notes.rationale: הנה snat n tikkal: isawal i win yettḥekkun iseqqimen d walhen ɣer wayen ara d-yas

translation: Wali, ass; wali, yusa-d; tifawt tufeɣ-d; tigejt tefri, timeɛrent tessuffeɣ-d ijefuren.
